_how_to: Maintained by Andrew via Muse: say 'freebie sent to <contractor>' or '<contractor> subscribed (<category>, <city>)' in the PermitPicker chat and Muse updates this file and pushes it. Entries: {contractor, phone, category (cost_guides id e.g. deck/kitchen/addition/pool/accessory/screened-porch/solar/roof, or 'all'), city (display city or ''), date (freebies) / since + status (subscribers: active|paused|cancelled), lead_id (freebies, optional)}.
